items.rationale: A context exists only for one session; a new session starts empty and only what is saved and loaded back can appear in it. Options a, c and d treat the model as if it keeps and loses memories on its own.
Call 1 sends 2,000 + 100 = 2,100. Call 2 sends 2,100 + 900 = 3,000. Call 3 sends 3,000 + 400 = 3,400. Total 2,100 + 3,000 + 3,400 = 8,500. The history is re-sent in full each call.

Retrieval loads only the few relevant chunks per request. Loading all manuals (b or c) is far beyond a practical window and is paid for on every call; training knowledge (d) does not contain the makerspace's manuals.

items.answer: The chunks the search returned, to tell a retrieval failure from the model misreading a correct page.
accepted: the retrieved chunks, to see if retrieval or the model is at fault
items.rationale: The model answers from what is in its context, so first check whether the right chunk was retrieved. If not, fix chunking or search; if it was, the fault is in how the model used it.
